method: All 11 original studio views and six world views inspected. Pixel evidence precedes diagnosis. Scores are subjective.

correctionResult.finding: The roof now has a distinct steeper upper slope and flatter eaves, with retained peak/eave endpoints and clear loft/porch. Freeze this profile.

boundedCorrection.family: closed roof enclosure and soffit representation
boundedCorrection.pixelFinding: Narrow bright/open strips appear between the far curved barge edge and inset gable shell, most clearly in front-left, rear-right and clay-rear. They are more visible with the new sweep. Enclosure regresses 0.88 to 0.80, exceeding 0.05.
boundedCorrection.diagnosis: The upper roof sheet has no visible closed underside across the overhang; camera rays can see background between forward bargeboard and recessed shell. This is distinct from the now-accepted profile identity.
boundedCorrection.hypothesis: Give the existing curved roof a real thin closed skin with underside and end caps, preserving upper silhouette and FrontSide rendering. Join its underside to the gable shell. Do not hide missing geometry with DoubleSide material.
boundedCorrection.requiredDelta: Enclosure at least 0.90 (+0.10), all critical views/categories at least 0.85; no critical regression over 0.05.
boundedCorrection.controls: Freeze accepted roof curve, cottage body, openings, terrace and neighbors. Finish remains withheld. Review 3 evaluates new family; review 4 is the final bounded correction opportunity.

assembly.findings: Moved scene barrel clears the entire front step and central approach (0.76 to 0.89). Rear threshold is free of rock and terrace rests on the visible coastline shelf. Elevated 45/135 views show separation from cottage01 annex and cottage03 without new neighbor clash. Foliage remains clear.
assembly.limitations: Cardinal 90/270 are heavily occluded by neighbors and are not independent clearance proof. Narrow cottage01 gap and rear support are accepted from complementary elevated/front/rear views. Roof enclosure remains a separate studio macro failure.

remainingTargetGap: Macro only; net rack, layered slate and finish intentionally absent. No exact inferred-reference identity claimed.
